# Ajmal Akhtar Azad — Mayor of Bhokraha Narsingh Municipality

> Official website of Mayor Ajmal Akhtar Azad of Bhokraha Narsingh Municipality, Sunsari, Nepal. News, vision, development projects, podcasts, gallery, and the KPL3 sports portal.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Mayor's official homepage with featured updates and live KPL3 match strip.
- [About](/about): Biography, background, and public service history of Mayor Ajmal Akhtar Azad.
- [Vision](/vision): Development priorities — infrastructure, healthcare, education, agriculture, digital governance.
- [News](/news): Latest news, press releases, and municipal updates with categories and search.
- [Podcasts](/podcasts): Audio and video podcasts from the Mayor's office.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photo gallery of events, projects, and public engagements.
- [Sports / KPL3](/sports): Karbala Premier League 3 portal with fixtures, live scores, teams, and standings.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact information and message form for the Mayor's office.

## Optional

- [RSS Feed](/rss.xml): News syndication feed.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap.
